build_autoencoder: build a drivable mesh VAE autoencoder with encoder, decoder, shadow net, and face modules
create_encoder: create a joint VAE encoder that encodes body geometry and texture into latent embeddings
create_convdecoder: create a multi-region view-independent decoder that reconstructs geometry and texture from latent embeddings
create_faceencoder: create a face encoder that encodes facial geometry and texture into latent face embeddings
create_unetviewdecoder: create a UNet-based view decoder that predicts view-dependent texture from geometry and camera position
